selection_analysis.selection_reason: The model-output shared cluster has the strongest combination of current unlock leverage and scenario density: 20 single-step unlock leverage, a 10-case dependency-closed primary core, and three selected cases on one already-used provider-retry fixture. Provider failover reuses existing ProviderAttempt helpers but has only two selected cases across two receipts and spans orchestration plus request/model/provider metadata. Source clusters have good 2/1 fixture density but would open an entirely new primitive surface. Broad higher-leverage primitives remain deferred because their immediately closed primary surfaces are semantically heterogeneous.
